errors.text_span: стойностите са отрицателни за всички показани икономики
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The value for Turkey (Турция) in the first quarter of 2020 (I трим. 2020) is slightly positive, at approximately +0.5%.

errors.text_span: Най-голямото намаление на БВП за първото тримесечие е за България, със стойност около -18%
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect in both the category and the value. The largest decrease in the first quarter is for France, Italy, and Spain (approx. -5.5%). The value for Bulgaria in the first quarter is approx. -3%. The value -18% corresponds to Spain's value in the second quarter.

errors.text_span: в диапазона от около -5% до -15% за първото тримесечие и от около -5% до -12% за второто тримесечие
errors.evidence: Both reported ranges are incorrect. The actual range for the first quarter is from approximately +0.5% (Turkey) to -5.5% (France, Italy, Spain). The actual range for the second quarter is from approximately -4.5% (Bulgaria, Russia) to -21% (United Kingdom).

errors.text_span: с изключение на Русия, която показва намаление около -5% за второто тримесечие
errors.evidence: The phrasing is illogical. It presents Russia as an exception to the previously stated (though incorrect) range for the second quarter ("-5% до -12%"). A value of -5% falls within this range, so it is not an exception, making the sentence confusing.
